original_question: On which chromosome is the HBB gene associated with the point mutation causing Hemoglobin C located?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the HBB gene associated with the point mutation causing Hemoglobin C located?
final_qi.long_answer: The HBB gene, which encodes the β-globin chain of hemoglobin, is located on the short arm of chromosome 11 (11p15.5). The single-nucleotide substitution in this gene that replaces glutamic acid with lysine at position 6 of the β-globin chain produces Hemoglobin C.
